lesson.title: Solve the client's real goal.
lines: The brief: hit the target on the whiteboard, consistently, from 6 ft.
A sheet of paper crumpled into a ball: 1 sheet, about 5 seconds to build, no skill, no prototypes.
The client said “paper plane.” The goal was the X.
